decisions.name: April 2021 EGLE/AECOM full Michigan WWTP PFAS report
decisions.reason: The 119-page report is distinct from the established 20-page June 2020 statewide summary. It is retained because its named tables identify Cadillac WWTP, publish three Cadillac effluent results and list one coded active Type II landfill SIU sample at 590 ng/L PFOA and 120 ng/L PFOS. The coded row does not name Wexford County Landfill and the report does not preserve a delivery record or establish migration to Plett Road.

decisions.name: May 2025 Pace UCMR5 plant-tap PFAS report — Crosby and 44 Road
decisions.reason: The 19-page report is a distinct second-round municipal drinking-water record. Its two primary samples are U-qualified as analyzed but not detected across the listed EPA 533 and EPA 537.1 PFAS panels. It is retained without representing the results as wastewater-process, Plett Road, leachate-delivery or source-to-receptor pathway evidence.

decisions.name: June 2020 EGLE statewide wastewater and biosolids PFAS summary
decisions.reason: The 20-page report has a distinct SHA-256 hash and preserves statewide regulatory and technical context for the 95-WWTP IPP initiative and the 42-WWTP/22-field assessment. It does not name Cadillac or Wexford or provide a facility-specific result, so it is retained in the PFAS library without a Cadillac timeline event and without closing a local source, time-series or migration-pathway requirement.

decisions.name: J19915-1 UDS Level 2 Report
decisions.reason: The two 22-page files have identical normalized text and matching report metadata. The older copy has cropped and overlapping pages 15-16; the complete reconstructed version replaces it without carrying a duplicate label.

decisions.name: Cadillac WWTP - IPP PFAS Interim Report Review messages
decisions.reason: Three MSG files share the same sent time, sender, recipients and five attachment hashes; two copies are suppressed and the cleanly named native message is retained.

decisions.name: FW: Biosolids PFAS - Cadillac
decisions.reason: The native MSG and seven-page PDF export contain the same email chain and attachment. The original Outlook message is retained and the PDF export is suppressed.

decisions.name: Six already represented records
decisions.reason: Five exact byte matches and one byte-different PDF with identical normalized text already have stable archive links; those links are reused rather than republishing copies.

decisions.name: Laboratory report, EDD and QA/QC packages
decisions.reason: Related files remain separate when their hashes, page structures and content roles differ; report, electronic-data and quality-control records are not mislabeled as duplicates.

decisions.name: Context and secondary records
decisions.reason: Ownership news, public statements, a scientific review and secondary water analysis are retained with explicit context labels so they are not presented as primary Cadillac PFAS measurements.

decisions.name: A12-A24 PFAS data, maps and agency records
decisions.reason: All 16 source records have distinct SHA-256 hashes and distinct formats, dates or evidentiary roles. The workbook, complete printable compilation, analytical subsets, dated heat maps, MPART presentations, public notice, management plan and biosolids guidance are preserved without applying duplicate labels.

decisions.name: April 18, 2018 DEQ PFAS-source follow-up
decisions.reason: The two-page agency letter is not a duplicate of the seven-page same-date Cadillac email package. It carries different sender, purpose and content: DEQ explains the landfill-leachate sampling initiative and the revised alternative-plan request deadline.
